Class StripeTransactionPostProcessor

public without sharing class StripeTransactionPostProcessor
implements ReplicationSettingsPostProcessor

Post-processor for scheduling the orchestration to process Stripe transactions. Implements ReplicationSettingsPostProcessor to automatically enqueue the first process when Stripe transactions are replicated, with configurable delay and lookback period.

public void execute(
  Id recordId,
  JSONUtils.JSONRecord payload
)

Implements/Overrides: ReplicationSettingsPostProcessor.execute(Id,JSONUtils.JSONRecord)

Executes the post-processing logic after a Stripe transaction replication event. This method enqueues the first job of the orchestration to process the records. Jobs in the orchestration include:
  1. StripeTransactionProcessor - Defines the database cursor and starts the orchestration.
  2. LinkStripeTransactionsToPayments - Links Stripe transactions to payment records based on matching criteria.
  3. AssignReferences - Extracts Customer, Card, and Transfer IDs from transactions and establishes StripeReference__c junction relationships.
  4. GetStripeBalanceTransactions - Retrieves balance transactions from Stripe to update payment records with fees.

Parameters:
    recordId – Not used in this implementation. Included to comply with interface requirements.
    payload – Not used in this implementation. Included to comply with interface requirements.
